steps.title: Prepare Tube Racks
steps.instruction: Precool 96-well microfuge tube racks on ice to maintain a cold chain and prevent RNA degradation.

steps.title: Label Microfuge Tubes
steps.instruction: Label 1.5 mL microfuge tubes with unique sample IDs using permanent markers or preprinted adhesive labels.

steps.title: Transfer Samples to Tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer filth fly samples into the corresponding pre-labeled 1.5 mL microfuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes sequentially onto the precooled microfuge tube rack

steps.title: Store Samples at -80 °C
steps.instruction: Secure the filled rack for long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Label the rack with a unique rack ID once full or all samples are completed
Secure the lid with clear saran wrap
Immediately transfer the rack to a -80 °C freezer

steps.title: Transfer Eluted Total Nucleic Acid
steps.instruction: In a clean PCR workstation, transfer eluted total nucleic acid (from KingFisher system Flex model 96-well microplate or Duo Prime elution strip) to a 96-well PCR microplate.

substeps.instruction: Keep samples on ice at all times
Maintain exact sample locations (e.g., A1 to A1, A2 to A2) corresponding to the original sample rack
Mark the 'A1' position on the 96-well microplate to ensure correct orientation

steps.title: Seal and Store Nucleic Acid
steps.instruction: Seal the 96-well PCR microplate and store at ultra-low temperature.

substeps.instruction: Cover the microplate with adhesive film to prevent spill over or contamination
Label the film with a unique plate ID
Immediately transfer the microplate to a -80 °C freezer
